svg.title: CompBench data, mask preprocessing, task-specific pipeline, and benchmark workflow
svg.desc: Four rounded base frames arranged left to right. f01 contains source data collection with a video strip, clapperboard dataset icon, and QA filtering icon. f02 contains mask preprocessing with multi-object mask examples, single masks, accept/reject symbols, a robot camera icon, and text about occlusion and continuity analysis. f03 contains a task-specific pipeline with text instructions, an implicit relation graph, chart/magnifier icon, and post-filtering label. f04 contains CompBench with paired image examples, task text, task document icon, lightbulb icon, and edit-count text. Large arrows connect adjacent frames horizontally.

g.desc: Origin is the title at top center. Downward are the video strip, then dataset icon/text, then QA filtering icon/text. Section uses vertical stacking symmetry around the panel center.

Origin is the mask preprocessing title. Downward-left is a multi-object mask block and downward-right is its label. Below it are separated masks, quality checks/crosses, and the robot camera icon with occlusion text. The middle row is horizontally equipartitioned into five mask/check columns.

Origin is the task-specific pipeline title. Downward are operation text, an implicit-relationship graphic with side labels, then a chart/magnifier icon and post-filtering text. The relation graphic has central symmetry around the square node.

Origin is the CompBench title. Downward is a pair of side-by-side example images, task text, then a task document icon, “9 tasks” text, lightbulb icon, and “3k+ Edits” text. The image pair is horizontally symmetric around the center gap.
SAM replacements confirmed from annotated overview: clapperboard, QA/shield icon, and small video strip components correspond to original objects in f01; true frame/text remain native SVG.
